lines.en: I am a statue; I cannot walk.

lines.zh: 我被搬动时整块挪过去。
lines.en: I get moved whole.
My stone base scrapes the floor.
I get shoved into a short slide.
My weight cracks the tiles.
I do not step; I am only moved.
I am lifted elsewhere, tipping.
I have only one pose, forever.

lines.zh: 我不走，我的影子跟着光走。
lines.en: I do not walk; my shadow follows the light.
I get pushed into the middle of the hall.
My ear scrapes the doorframe.
I make no footstep.
I stand like stone grown a face.
My surface is rough and scratched.
I neither breathe nor rot.
My grin is cut into the material.
I have stood here a long time.
My fingers curl stiffly.
The light hits me and I do not shine.
A layer of dust has settled on me.
A piece of my ear is missing.

lines.zh: 我像在等一场不会开的秀。
lines.en: I wait for a show that will never open.
I face this way, always.
You stop in front of me.
My eyes have no focus.
I am looking at you, possibly.
My chin tucks slightly.
You run a hand over my shoulder.
My surface is cold.
You step back; I am still looking.
My grin has not faded.
A piece flakes off my surface.
I tip slightly, but do not fall.
A corner of my grin is missing.
You strike me and your hand jars.
I feel no pain, only a chip.
My base shifts half an inch.
Dust coats me.
I have gathered more scratches.
I remain perfectly motionless.
My ear comes off entirely.
I do not even have a mouth.
I cannot hold what you offer.
It sits at my feet; I do not look.
You hold it high and I still do not move.
Statues do not eat.
It rolls onto my base and stops.
I have no stomach and no wants.
You cannot buy me with food.
My grin does not change for it.
I keep the expression I was carved with.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，我只掉了一点灰。
lines.en: You hit me; only dust falls.
My weight makes you give way.
You hit my knee.

lines.zh: 我的手指刮到你的衣服。
lines.en: My fingers snag your clothes.
I am not pushed.
The impact sounds like stone.
I tip a very little.

lines.zh: 你的肩撞在我的底座上。
lines.en: Your shoulder hits my base.

lines.zh: 我身上又多了一道刮痕。
lines.en: A new scratch appears on me.
I barely lose any dust.
Two statues stand face to face.
We wear the same expression.
Dust covers everything between them.

lines.zh: 我们的影子在墙上叠住。
lines.en: Our shadows lie on top of each other.

lines.zh: 我们都不会朝对方靠近。
lines.en: Neither of us will ever come closer.
They are arranged as a pair.
My base touches its base.

lines.zh: 我们一起朝着同一个门口。
lines.en: We face the same doorway together.

lines.zh: 我们这样的话已经很久了。
lines.en: We have been like this a long time.
There are no words between stones.

lines.zh: 我没有可以抓东西的手。
lines.en: I have no hand to grasp with.
I cannot pick anything up.
It wedges in my stone seams.

lines.zh: 它落在我的肩上，没有滑下去。
lines.en: It lands on my shoulder and stays.
You push it into my fist's gap.
It changes my outline a little.
I remain in my original pose.
It slowly slides to the floor.
Not one of my fingers moves.
I have no way to lock onto anyone.
I merely stand here.
I make not the slightest move.
My eyes point a fixed way.

lines.zh: 你在我面前，我没有回应。
lines.en: You are before me and I do not respond.
I have no legs to chase with.

lines.zh: 我身上没有怒气这东西。
lines.en: There is no such thing as anger in me.

lines.zh: 你开始退，我什么都没做。
lines.en: You begin to back off; I have done nothing.
My shadow reaches your feet.

lines.zh: 我不是活的，也不打算是。
lines.en: I am not alive, and do not intend to be.
You read hostility into my grin.
I keep this angle.
I keep facing the corridor.
I have never chosen anything.
You leave; I still face this way.
My position has never changed.
You look back and I am still standing.
My pose is a kind of threat.
You circle twice; I am still there.
I neither chase nor hide.
You slow down and finally stop.
My shadow always reaches toward you.

lines.zh: 你听见的只有自己的脚步。
lines.en: You hear only your own steps.

lines.zh: 灯光一变，我的脸更清楚。
lines.en: The light shifts and my face is clearer.
You count how many statues remain.
I make no move of any kind.
You cannot tell whether I moved.
I have always been in that spot.

lines.zh: 你离开时又看了我一眼。
lines.en: You look at me once more as you go.
My grin is behind you.
I do not need to follow you.
I remember your back as you leave.

lines.zh: 我一直在原地看着这边。
lines.en: I have always watched from here.
I cannot raise a hand.
You run into me and only then touch you.
My base jams into your knee.

lines.zh: 我的石头手指刮过你的袖。
lines.en: My stone fingers scrape your sleeve.

lines.zh: 这不是攻击，是我的存在。
lines.en: This is not an attack; it is my presence.
I block your way.
My ear knocks your head.
You fall into me and hit stone.

lines.zh: 我的边角划破了你的皮。
lines.en: My edge cuts your skin.
I did not move once.

lines.zh: 你的拳头打在我身上，疼的是你。
lines.en: You punch me and your hand hurts.
I rest on your foot, heavy.
You cannot move me at all.
I tip half an inch and hit you.
The grin is still on my face.
At last you go around me.

lines.zh: 我的石头重量压在你身上。
lines.en: My stone weight settles on you.
I pin you in the corner.
I tip over straight into you.

lines.zh: 你的剑砍在石头上滑开了。
lines.en: Your blade slides off my stone.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头多了一尊石像。
lines.en: A stone figure appears at the hall's end.
I am set against the wall.

lines.zh: 这里的灰忽然厚了一块。
lines.en: A patch of dust here has thickened.

lines.zh: 我的底座压出四个印子。
lines.en: My base presses four marks into the floor.
A new shadow appears under the light.

lines.zh: 一尊紫色的雕像立起来了。
lines.en: A purple statue stands upright.

lines.zh: 你听见石头落地的声音。
lines.en: You hear stone settle.

lines.zh: 五点的雕像，连晃都不会。
lines.en: A statue with five health does not even sway.
This floor has gained an exhibit.

lines.zh: 没有人记得是谁搬来的。
lines.en: No one remembers who moved me here.
My face slowly comes into the light.

lines.zh: 我出现时没有半点声音。
lines.en: I appeared without a whisper.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的表面，颜色变深了。
lines.en: Fire bakes my surface a darker shade.
I fall whole with a heavy thud.

lines.zh: 水渗进石缝，我变得很沉。
lines.en: Water seeps into my seams and I grow heavy.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，摔成两段。
lines.en: The blast flips me and I break in two.
An arrow lodges in the stone.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我的表情抹淡了。
lines.en: That force blurs my expression.
Stone never feels hunger.

lines.zh: 雷击在我身上，石头裂了一线。
lines.en: Lightning splits a line through me.

lines.zh: 底座下面空了，我整块下坠。
lines.en: The floor is gone and I drop whole.
